title: Dromo
description: An adaptive running planner for iPhone that sends structured workouts to Apple Watch. No account, no backend — your training stays on your device.
features: Builds an adaptive plan for a 5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon, or running without a race — with training phases, recovery weeks, and capped weekly volume increases.
Estimates current fitness from race results and running history, with Apple cardio fitness as supporting evidence, and sets targets by pace, heart rate, or perceived effort.
Sends every structured session (warm-up, intervals, recovery) to Apple Watch through WorkoutKit — no separate Watch app to install.
Adapts future sessions as runs and check-ins arrive; illness and pain reporting steps the plan back and guides the return.
Beginner run/walk plans with stage check-ins, plus time-goal plans with feasibility checks and race-specific work.
Matches runs from Apple Health automatically with read-only access; Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show upcoming training.
Private by design: no account, no server, no tracking. Training files are protected and kept out of automatic backups, with manual export and restore.
Fully localized in English and Greek, with a 600+ test suite covering the plan engine, Health, and Watch services.
